stopRun.summary: Stop the job and clear the controller's buffer

resumeRun.summary: Resume a paused job or tool change

toggleCamera.summary: Turn the webcam stream on or off

queryCamera.summary: Ask whether the camera is streaming

moveTo.summary: Move the sled to a point picked on the viewer

setMaxZ.summary: Store the current Z as the upper limit

setMinZ.summary: Store the current Z as the lower limit

getZlimits.summary: Ask the controller to report its Z limits

reportSettings.summary: Ask the controller for its settings ($$)

defineZ0.summary: Define the current Z as zero

touchZ.summary: Probe Z with the touch plate

moveToDefault.summary: Move to the default chain lengths

returnToCenter.summary: Move the sled to the bed centre

moveGcodeZ.summary: Step the gcode index to the next or previous Z move

startRun.summary: Start sending the loaded gcode, or resume a job the controller paused or a tool change

update.summary: Install a WebControl release and restart

acceptTriangularCalibrationResults.summary: Store the last triangular calibration result

acceptHoleyCalibrationResults.summary: Store the last holey calibration result

opticalRetryCell.summary: Measure the optical square that failed again

opticalSkipCell.summary: Leave the optical square that failed unmeasured and go on

resetChainLengths.summary: Tell the controller the chains are at their default lengths

defineHome.summary: Define home at a point, or at the sled when both args are empty

testMotors.summary: Run each motor in both directions

setSprockets.summary: Turn a sprocket by an angle

rotateSprocket.summary: Run a motor at full speed for a time

setSprocketAutomatic.summary: Turn the sprockets to vertical automatically

setSprocketsZero.summary: Define the current sprocket angles as zero

setSprocketsDefault.summary: Mark the chains as at their default lengths

updatePorts.summary: Rescan serial ports; answered by an updatePorts message

adjustChain.summary: Extend one chain after a 5 s countdown

boardProcessGCode.summary: Mark the loaded gcode's area as cut on the current board

boardClearBoard.summary: Clear the current board's cut area

updatePyInstaller.summary: Install the newer PyInstaller release and restart

setFakeServo.summary: Turn the controller's fake servo on or off

resetHomeToCenter.summary: Move home back to the bed centre

park.summary: Raise Z to the safe height and rapid to the park position (Rust only)

definePark.summary: Make the sled's current position the park position (Rust only)
